Manifest.Name: Anime Universe — Recycler Machine
Manifest.Author: New Anime Universe
Manifest.Description: A vanilla-style recycling machine with an input bay large enough for the double batch. Processes four Junk into one Scrap Metal overnight; at 50% performance it can process eight Junk into two Scrap Metal. Efficiency modules reduce power use; Quality modules have no effect. Not granted for free; purchase from Kaito.
